integration.sampling: Native 1x sizes target a 1280x720 canvas. Pixel-aligned positions with nearest filtering keep edges crisp. Disable mipmaps for these GUI textures.
integration.text: No text is baked into assets. Render labels independently. Stepper + and - marks and other requested UI symbols are intentional pictograms.

integration.portrait: portrait_frame has a transparent central window. Place portrait art below it.
